title: Nobody Told You AI Images Could Do This Now
description:
Ideogram 4.0 just went open-weight: you can download the actual 9.3-billion-parameter model, run it on your own hardware, and fine-tune it on your own brand. It's ranked the #1 open image model out there (only one closed lab still beats it), with near-perfect text rendering and drag-and-place layout control. #Shorts #AIImageGenerator

Get the full download + fine-tune guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1k3Ru2a_hUkd7BN-yfOnZlqlmO7lp_I5pqKMi2FyeibE/edit?usp=sharing
